meta.title: Fistashion — The Bakery House | Haute Pâtisserie & Specialty Coffee Medina
meta.description: An oasis of French artisanal pastry, Mediterranean pistachio creations, and specialty coffee in Medina Al-Munawwarah. Located on the 1st line beside the Islamic University.

hero.tagline: Inspired by grand Parisian salons and genuine Medina hospitality.
hero.lead: Step into an oasis of white Calacatta marble, emerald green, and warm brass. Savor 72-hour slow-fermented French viennoiserie, stone-ground Mediterranean pistachios, and masterfully pulled single-origin coffee.

about.title: One House. Two Traditions.
about.lead: Where timeless French pâtisserie mastery meets the legendary warmth of Medina hospitality.
about.p1: Fistashion was born from a singular conviction: genuine luxury should not feel cold or distant. From our 27-layer laminated puff pastries to our house-roasted Mediterranean pistachios, every creation is crafted by hand under the eyes of our master bakers.
about.p2: Situated on a prominent first line beside the Islamic University, our grand salon welcomes scholars, families, travelers, and coffee connoisseurs for quiet dawn reflections and joyful evening gatherings.

pistache.title: Pistache d'Or
pistache.desc: Rare Mediterranean & Bronte pistachios, stone-ground into silky in-house praline.

lart.title: L'Art Français
lart.desc: 72-hour cold fermentation and 100% French Normandy butter lamination.

cafe.title: Specialty Roast
cafe.desc: Direct-trade single-origin beans, precision-calibrated for exquisite balance.

menu.title: Signature Creations & Tasting Notes
menu.lead: Each recipe is an ode to craftsmanship, balancing buttery flakiness with roasted pistachio depth.

items.name: Le Croissant Suprême Pistache
items.desc: 27 delicate layers of golden French puff pastry filled with velvety in-house pistachio cream, crowned with roasted Sicilian emerald pistachios.
items.notes: Crisp Normandy butter • House praline • Sea salt note

items.name: Tartelette Pistache & Fleur d'Oranger
items.desc: Delicate sablé breton crust, infused pistachio ganache, roasted pistachio crunch, and an aromatic whisper of orange blossom.
items.notes: Pure pistachio ganache • Orange blossom • Crunchy sablé

items.name: Pain au Chocolat Gianduja
items.desc: Slow-leavened buttery dough cradling double Valrhona dark chocolate batons and roasted hazelnut praline.

items.name: Fistashion Signature Pistachio Latte
items.desc: Double shot of single-origin Colombian espresso blended with silky steamed milk and our artisanal Mediterranean pistachio reduction.
items.notes: Nutty crema • Silky texture • Subtle sweetness

items.name: V60 Single-Origin Ethiopian Reserve
items.desc: Lightly roasted heirloom beans from Yirgacheffe, hand-dripped to unlock jasmine floral aromas and citrus bergamot brightness.

items.name: Brioche Feuilletée & Truffle Fromage
items.desc: Airy braided brioche layered with artisanal Gruyère cheese and a touch of black summer truffle, baked golden brown.
items.notes: Melted aged cheese • Earthy truffle • Flaky crumb

offerings.title: Fresh Daily from Our Ovens
offerings.lead: From early dawn to late evening, our bakers and baristas maintain an unwavering standard of excellence.
offerings.noteDesc: Custom emerald-and-gold gift hampers, corporate dessert boxes, and private event catering tailored to your celebration.

atmosphere.title: Character Without Distance
atmosphere.lead: We designed our Medina salon as a serene sanctuary where aesthetic beauty meets effortless comfort.

items.interior: White Calacatta marble, custom emerald millwork, and glowing brass halo chandeliers.
items.assortment: Uncompromising French baking techniques combined with regional pistachio heritage.
items.guests: Scholars, families, travelers, and morning coffee seekers united in conversation.
items.style: A discreet visual language of gold hairlines, fine linens, and bespoke porcelain.
items.idea: Luxury made generous — honest pricing that makes artisan pleasure a daily ritual.
items.service: Attentive, graceful service rooted in the venerable tradition of Madinah hospitality.

experience.title: Thoughtfully Designed For You
experience.lead: Everything you need to know before visiting our flagship salon.

location.title: First Line & Valet Parking
location.desc: Located directly on the primary avenue beside the Islamic University of Madinah, with ample dedicated parking for cars and families.

hours.title: 7:00 AM – Midnight Daily
hours.desc: Fresh morning viennoiserie hot out of the ovens from early dawn, through relaxed afternoon tea and late evening coffee.

ambience.title: Family & Executive Salon
ambience.desc: Spacious seating options, from private booths for family comfort to sunlit marble tables ideal for reading and thoughtful discussion.

gifting.title: Luxury Emerald Gift Boxes
gifting.desc: Pre-order signature dessert boxes adorned with embossed gold foil — an honorable gift for gatherings and honored visits.

location.title: Visit Us in Medina
location.p1: Commanding a prime first-line position beside the Islamic University, Fistashion is a landmark of architectural elegance and culinary delight.
location.p2: Effortlessly accessible from Prince Naif Road and the central districts, featuring comfortable parking for families and visiting guests.

franchise.title: Grow the House With Us
franchise.lead: We invite visionary partners and investors to expand the Fistashion standard across the Kingdom and beyond. Join a turnkey culinary brand with proven margins and exceptional guest loyalty.
franchise.perk1Desc: Complete interior specifications, Calacatta marble procurement guides, and signature emerald fixture standards.
franchise.perk2Desc: Direct access to our Mediterranean pistachio orchards, French Normandy butter partners, and master coffee roasters.
franchise.perk3Desc: Rigorous hands-on curriculum, operational playbooks, and continuous culinary audits to safeguard brand prestige.
